overview: Track ICP neuron and WTN position rewards with snapshots, portfolio stats, and NNS governance sync, protected by an invitation-code access control system.
features: Dashboard with portfolio summary and reward stats
Add and manage ICP neurons with NNS governance sync
Add and manage WTN (WaterNeuron nICP) positions
Daily reward snapshots with event classification
Invitation-code access control with admin bootstrap
Admin panel to generate, list, and revoke invite codes
Owner-only bootstrap to establish admin and self-access
